source_row.extraction_instructions: CoBlocks Events carousel (JS-rendered) with two blocks: BESS events and third-party events. Slides carry day/month/year spans (ranges like 30-2 / June - July), title, a description span holding the event link, time and location. Slides without a link have no page. Fees for BESS courses sit on a WooCommerce /product/<slug>/ page linked from the event page (price plus Out of stock flag).

concerns: Listing path: DOM (CoBlocks event-item slides, JS-rendered swiper). The posts REST endpoint holds news, not events; no events API exists. Only 3 slides are not past: this is a small society with few dated events, hence partial.

Elevate (13-14 Oct) is in progress today and out of stock; it is kept because end_date >= today (family rule). It is archived by tomorrow's run anyway. The brief said start_date >= today; this one would be dropped under that stricter reading.

BESS-ORUK (18 Nov) is hosted on oruk.org: the detail is read from that partner page (venue line, 4 early-bird tiers, CPD 'applied for' stored as cpd_accredited false). BESS 2027 Manchester has no page ('Coming soon!'); it uses a listing#slug URL and slide data only.

Coverage checklist verified: same-site registration page (WooCommerce /product/<slug>/ followed via fetch_html for price and Out of stock), external partner registration (ORUK ticket list parsed), image/PDF fee tables and CFP (none seen). BESS 2026 (Newcastle, 24-26 June) and the Elbow Updates Symposium (Mar 2026) are past; the 'Other Courses and Events' block (SECEC, BOA, ICSES) is all past today, but upcoming third-party slides would be ingested as events with the external link.
